title: Simple Marriage
description: A port of Marriage Master to Fabric with extra features
body:
This is a simple port of the **[Marriage Master](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/marriage-master-mc-1-7-1-21.19273/)** plugin to Fabric, along with adding extra commands and features like partner health tracking and a status command. 

There's also some different configs including the ability to disable homes and tp indivudally.

Created for a friend modpack and uploaded for people or couples who wanna play fabric and be married at the same time without having to try to use hybrid servers.


<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>
These are generally ported from the original mod with a few expections which are noted. 

- /marry <player> - Propose to the target player
- /marry accept - Accepts a proposal request
- /marry deny - Denies a proposal request
- /marry divorce - Divorces your current marriage
- /marry gift - Gives your partner your current held item
- /marry pvp - Toggles partner pvp, both partners must have pvp on to attack each other
- /marry sethome - Sets the marriage home at your location
- /marry home - Teleports you to the marriage home
- /marry tp - Teleports you to your partner
- /marry chat - Toggles marriage chat
- /marry partnerhealth - Toggles the health display for your partner on action bar (Added by Simple Marriage)
- /marry status - Gets the status of various marriage things (Added by Simple Marriage)
- /marriageadmin reload - Reloads the marriage file
- /marriageadmin force-divorce <player> - Force divorces a couple

</details>

You can find the original plugin and it's **source code** + **license** [here](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/marriage-master-mc-1-7-1-21.19273/).

Thank you to [GeorgH93](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/authors/georgh93.2396/) for making the amazing plugin that is Marriage Master.
